name: Gustave Stoltze
bio: Gustave Stoltze was a draughtsman for the N. P. R. C. Co. when he visited Medora in February 1884. In July 1884, when he was in town again, the paper called him the company's architect.

moments.label: Visited Medora as the company's architect

mentions: Lawyer Carpenter, of Dickinson, has been in town for several days on legal business.
Gustave Stoltze, who is in the employment of the N. P. R. C. Co., as draughtsman, is in town for a few days.
Gustave Stoltze, the company's architect, was here yesterday.
